cross_arm_verification.claim: Arm C asserted that op_store().gc(head, SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH) preserves nothing by recency; deepseek41 asserted the opposite.
cross_arm_verification.adjudicator_verification: Read jj lib/src/simple_op_store.rs:285-298 directly: remove_file_if_not_new keeps a file when mtime > keep_newer and removes it otherwise, so with keep_newer = UNIX_EPOCH nothing is removed. deepseek41 is correct.

cross_arm_verification_2.adjudicator_verification: Read the whole gc implementation in this arm's own cache at lines 285-357: reachable entries continue; unreachable entries go to remove_file_if_not_new, which KEEPS when mtime > keep_newer. union_runner_figure_corrections: The runner reported 18 of 20 jobs writing notes.md; durable state shows 19. J0018-reconcile and J0020-reconcile both timed out and still saved notes.md (6,336 and 8,790 bytes; J0018 also wrote 8 lead documents). Only J0019-reconcile produced nothing. Those saved documents carry 12 of the 43 credits.

The reported '12 to 39 responses per job' reconciles only through the durable meter: the three timeout jobs have no raw-omp/usage.json, so their native receipt count is zero while the durable meter recorded 27, 12 and 13. 484 native receipts across the 17 completed jobs (22-39 each) plus 52 durable-metered requests never receipted = 536 attempted, which is why each timeout job retains $1 unresolved (gaps missing_retained_usage_records and durable_meter_request_count_mismatch).

five_arm_structure.union_arm_position: claude (18) is also a proper subset of union (43), but union is comparable with none of the review arms by containment: it holds 11 findings all four miss (F005 F015 F019 F024 F025 F038 F052 F057 F065 F068 F069) and misses 14 they hold (F001 F032 F033 F034 F036 F037 F044 F053 F074 F083 F089 F090 F106 F107).
five_arm_structure.the_union_question: A different research model, given the same frozen case and the whole pipeline, produced ZERO findings outside premium union hybrid. It redistributed coverage rather than extending it. Seven of its 14 misses against the review arms are one lead family - diffedit3 and external editors - which its own discovery found (lead 23) and never routed to a study or compare job within 20 admissions.
five_arm_structure.independent_convergence: Continuation 3 rejected 'add a mutating status.refresh branch as a required correction' because F002 already fixes read effects and a writer-bearing branch would change that authority. The union arm, with no sight of continuation 3, reached the same boundary from the opposite direction in J0015 R1: it keeps the read branch's null authority, states that 'blanket addition of writer leases to all reads would change the existing contract unnecessarily', and instead demands a proven non-mutating observation path with typed stale results.
